sections.label: The Freelance Days
sections.heading: The Beginning of My Journey
sections.text: When I first jumped into the tech world as a freelancer, building websites felt like a thrilling adventure. But soon, I discovered a shocking truth: secure hosting options were nearly impossible to find. The hosting companies I came across charged sky-high fees and often left security in the dust.

sections.label: The Wake-Up Call
sections.heading: A Wake-Up Call
sections.text: My journey took a wild turn when I encountered two unreliable hosting providers. One faced a serious data breach, leaving my clients in panic, while the other hiked their prices overnight due to rising cPanel fees. I lost over 150 websites—projects that took me countless hours to create. My clients were furious, and I felt crushed. As a cybersecurity professional, this was a wake-up call. How could I protect my clients when these companies failed me?

sections.label: A Company is Born
sections.heading: The Birth of 1Only Host
sections.text: In the chaos, I realized I had to take matters into my own hands. I envisioned a hosting company that prioritized security, reliability, and affordability. And that's how 1Only Host began, with a mission to provide 99% security and unbeatable uptime.

sections.label: Building the Foundation
sections.heading: Starting from Scratch
sections.text: With just a small VPS server and a lot of determination, I started this journey in 2019. The first year was a whirlwind of manual sales and building connections, often late into the night. It wasn't until 2020 that I finally secured the name 1OnlyHost.com.

sections.label: Growth & Recognition
sections.heading: Our Growth and Achievements
sections.text: Today, I'm excited to share that we have built a strong reputation in the VPS and dedicated server space, partnering with numerous data centers worldwide. We provide a comprehensive range of services, from domain registration to hosting solutions, including VPS, dedicated, and cloud servers. Each of our offerings reflects our commitment to creating a safe and empowering environment for businesses of all sizes.

sections.label: Raising the Standard
sections.heading: A Shift Toward Premium Excellence
sections.text: 2025 marked a major transformation for 1OnlyHost. As our infrastructure, support systems, and service quality evolved, we made the strategic decision to move beyond traditional affordable hosting and step into the premium hosting space. This transition was more than a pricing adjustment—it reflected our commitment to delivering greater value. We upgraded our shared hosting and reseller hosting plans with enhanced performance, stronger security, improved resource allocation, and more reliable support to match the elevated standards we set for ourselves. By investing in better technology and better customer experiences, we ensured that every service under 1OnlyHost delivered premium-quality hosting backed by real expertise and dependable infrastructure.

sections.label: Beyond Hosting
sections.heading: Building Technology, Support & Innovation
sections.text: By 2026, 1OnlyHost evolved beyond being just a hosting provider. Leveraging years of experience in infrastructure management and cybersecurity, we expanded into providing professional IT and technical support services for web hosting companies worldwide. Our team began supporting hosting businesses behind the scenes, helping them manage servers, strengthen security, and deliver better experiences to their own customers. At the same time, 1OnlyHost entered a new era of innovation by launching powerful tools and introducing new products designed to simplify hosting, automation, and digital infrastructure management. Our mission grew stronger—to not only provide hosting solutions, but to build technology, deliver expert support, and create products that empower businesses and hosting providers alike. Today, 1OnlyHost stands as a growing technology brand driven by innovation, security, and a commitment to shaping the future of digital services.

faq.title: Your Web Hosting Questions Answered
faq.subtitle: Get clear and concise answers to all your web hosting questions.

items.a: 1Only Host, established in 2019, is based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We offer web hosting services with data centers in seven countries: India, the USA, the UK, Germany, Australia, Singapore, and France.

items.q: What features do I get with web hosting?
items.a: With our web hosting plans, you get reliable uptime, fast loading speeds, free SSL certificates, one-click installations for apps, and 24/7 customer support. Plus, you’ll enjoy easy scalability and user-friendly control panels.
Our technical support team is dedicated to helping you anytime you need it. Available 24/7, we provide prompt assistance through live chat, email, and phone. Your satisfaction is our priority!

items.q: Is 1Only Host good for my business website?
items.a: Yes, 1Only Host is an excellent choice for your business website. Our robust infrastructure ensures your site runs smoothly, helping you reach your audience effectively.

items.q: Are 1Only Host’s hosting services for non-techies?
items.a: Yes! Our hosting services are designed for everyone, including non-techies. Our easy-to-use interface and helpful resources make it simple for anyone to get started.

items.q: What security measures do you include?
items.a: We prioritize your security with features like free SSL certificates, regular backups, and advanced firewalls. Your website’s safety is our top concern.

items.q: Can I migrate my website to 1Only Host?
items.a: Absolutely! We offer free website migration services to ensure a smooth transition to 1Only Host. Just contact our support team, and we’ll handle the rest.
Choose 1Only Host for our exceptional reliability, affordable pricing, user-friendly features, and outstanding customer support. We are committed to helping you succeed online.

items.q: What kind of web hosting services do you offer?
items.a: We offer a variety of web hosting services, including shared hosting, reseller hosting, VPS Servers, Dedicated Servers, Cloud Servers and student hosting. No matter your needs, we have a plan for you!

items.q: How to get started with 1Only Host web hosting?
items.a: Getting started with 1Only Host is easy! Follow these three simple steps: 1. Choose a hosting plan that fits your needs. 2. Register your domain name. 3. Add everything to your cart and complete the payment. And just like that, you're ready to launch your website!

items.q: How long does the hosting account setup take?
items.a: We offer instant account setup! Once you place your order and complete payment, your hosting account will be set up immediately. No waiting, just start your online journey!

items.q: Can I buy web hosting without a domain name?
items.a: Yes, you can purchase web hosting without a domain name. While we offer a free domain with select hosting plans, you can use your existing domain by simply updating the name servers at your registrar.
